verdict.rationale: Llama is an open-weight model family, distributed as weights plus a model download and verification CLI. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a workflow-platform capability, not an axis that applies to a model family. Nothing in the evidence shows Llama ships any automation layer with version history or rollback. The single 'multi-agent coding in your terminal' mention does not describe automation versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
